title: Lima Art Museum
representedDate: Restored 2022 state of the exterior of the 1870–1871 exhibition palace.
geometryBasis: Exact mapped standing palace perimeter with projecting pavilions and separately modeled documented central courtyard.
sectionBasis: Original relief fixed before geometry. The NARA photograph controls the facade modules and crest proportions. Official conservation records support retained cornices, balustrades and both central pavilions. Vertical heights are estimated.
limitations: Facade and roof heights, side bay spacing, relief sculpture and colors are interpretations. The terrace and plinth adapt to mapped grade.

Central courtyard width comes from a Universidad de San Martín de Porres measured study. Selected interior galleries, site parking, neighboring buildings and park monuments are outside the modeled exterior.
Current museum restoration report controls the standing building. The archival photograph predates that work.
